versions.changelog: Cross-week dedup: reads the most recent file in briefings/ and skips already-covered items unless there's a material new development. Mandatory source-date spot-check: top 3 items and any fuzzy-dated item get their publish date confirmed on the source page via WebFetch. Two new quality gates. Ships the published briefing archive (briefings/).

English-only docs and output templates (default output language switched to English, multilingual support retained). Fixed evals skill_name (was agentic-commerce-scout). Added MIT-0 LICENSE. Now mirrored on GitHub: github.com/xuxinmaxen/agentic-commerce-news.

agentic-commerce-news 1.0.1

- Clarified the skill's description, emphasizing triggers like "AI shopping agent startups", "agent checkout products", and general requests for agentic commerce updates — even when the skill isn't named explicitly.
- Expanded trigger examples to include broader, more natural user questions about agentic commerce news, funding, or setting up digests.
- No changes to logic or workflow; only the description was improved for usability and discoverability.
- No code or functionality changes detected in this version.
Initial release: agentic commerce weekly news briefing with 9-layer taxonomy
